content.value: Boom and Crash indices spike a fixed percentage of ticks on a fixed interval, but the ticks immediately before a spike are not random. They accumulate in a recognisable curve. A cluster accumulator reads that curve in real time and fires the entry arrow when the mathematical exhaustion point is reached — one to three ticks before the explosion prints.
Cluster accumulation (Prime Spike v3.2 AI): models the tick-by-tick accumulation curve and marks mathematical exhaustion.
Variance anomaly (Sigma Nexus Quantum): requires a 3.2-sigma deviation from the rolling mean before an entry is permitted.
Liquidity pressure (NexusPainGain Detector X): reads orderbook imbalance and directional sweeps, exclusive to Weltrade Pain X and Gain X.

Every calculation binds to a closed micro-tick. The moment an arrow prints it is written into the chart history permanently, and it can never shift backwards or vanish when the next candle opens. That is not a feature we added — it is a property of how the model is bound to the tick stream.
